heading: A small range, chosen around real fields.
seoDescription: How the fictional Kivu Seedworks cooperative connects field context, practical guidance, and a compact product range.

body.html:
Kivu Seedworks began with one recurring problem: growers were offered long catalogues before anyone asked about the field.

The cooperative works in the other direction. It starts with location, crop, acreage, and planting week, then narrows the choice to what can be delivered and used well.
